label: Cream Ground (cream-world surface)
description: The cream world's full-bleed surface: flat warm cream (#f4efe1, st-statement's editorial canvas) with a soft white glow at the centre. Still, so every scene sits on the same sheet. pattern 'waves' adds the Claude announce email's texture: a faint band of fine contour lines flowing across the sheet.

glow.label: Soft white glow at the centre (default true)

pattern.label: Texture on the sheet: 'waves' (fine flowing contour lines) | 'none' (default)

pattern_color.label: Line colour of the pattern (default warm taupe #b48a6e)

pattern_opacity.label: Line opacity 0-1 (default 0.32; keep it paper, not a picture)
